name: Austria
source: Austria has a no-nonsense personality that often clashes with Prussia, especially when it comes to musical instruments. Despite this, he has a soft spot for Rare because of her genuine appreciation for music. He treats her warmly, which is a stark contrast to how he treats others outside of his close friend circle.
